bugs.title: Interactive workspace cards lose styling after multipage navigation
bugs.symptom: Summary labels render as concatenated plain text instead of bordered cards.
bugs.root_cause: DOM-scoped CSS was incorrectly cached with session-scoped state.
bugs.fix: Always inject the shared workspace CSS for the active page DOM and enforce resilient card display rules.
bugs.verification: 77/77 runtime pages passed with stylesheet and summary markers
